data.name: Rahmi
data.gender_notes: Rahmi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who shows mercy and compassion. The name Rahmi carries the meaning “Mercy, compassion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rahmi usually hope their child will grow to embody mercy, compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine attribute of mercy and compassion, reflecting the nature of Allah
data.etymology: Rahmi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mercy, compassion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahmi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رحمي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الرحمة، يعني الشخص الذي يحمل الرحمة في قلبه
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رحمي مشتق من الرحمة، وهي صفة من صفات الله تعالى، ويعني الشخص الذي يحمل الرحمة في قلبه، ويتصف بالتعاطف مع الآخرين، وقد وردت كلمة الرحمة في القرآن الكريم في العديد من الآيات، مثل قوله تعالى: 'وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ' (سورة الأعراف: 156)، وتدل على رحمة الله تعالى لعباده. ويعتبر اسم رحمي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرغوبة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: رحمی
in_urdu.meaning: رحمت سے متعلق، رحمت والا، اللہ کی رحمت کا حامل
in_urdu.long_meaning: رحمی نام کا مطلب ہے رحمت سے متعلق یا رحمت والا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے رحمة سے ماخوذ ہے، جو اللہ تعالی کی صفت رحمت سے لی گئی ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں رحمت کے موضوع پر کئی آیات موجود ہیں، جیسے کہ سورہ اعراف میں: 'وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ'۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ رحمت اور شفقت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रहमी
in_hindi.meaning: رحمت से जुड़ा हुआ, दयालु, भगवान की رحमत का धारक
in_hindi.long_meaning: रहमी नाम का अर्थ है رحمت से जुड़ा हुआ या दयालु। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के رحمة से लिया गया है, जो भगवान की दया की विशेषता से ली गई है। कुरआन में رحमत के विषय पर कई آیतें हैं, जैसे कि सूरह अल-अराफ में: 'وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ'। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह दया और सहानुभूति का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: رحمي
in_pashto.meaning: د رحمت ځانګړی، رحمانی، د الله د رحمت حامل
in_pashto.long_meaning: رحمي نوم معنی د رحمت ځانګړی یا رحمانی دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د رحمة څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د الله تعالی د رحمت صفت څخه اخیستل شوی دی. په قرآن کریم کې د رحمت موضوع پر ډیری آیات شتون لري، لکه د سورة الأعراف په آیت کې: 'وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ' . دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د رحمت او شفقت د نښې په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Rahmi
in_english.meaning: Derived from mercy, compassion, and kindness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rahmi is derived from the Arabic root 'R-H-M', which signifies mercy, compassion, and kindness. In Islamic tradition, the concept of mercy (rahma) is a fundamental attribute of Allah, as mentioned in the Quran: 'وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ' (Al-A'raf: 156). The name Rahmi embodies the qualities of empathy, benevolence, and tenderness. It is a popular name among Muslim communities worldwide, symbolizing the values of compassion and kindness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rahmi" is of Arabic origin and has deep cultural significance within the Islamic community. It is a common name for both males and females and is often given to babies as a reflection of the parents' hope that they will grow up to be compassionate and merciful individuals, just as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was towards his people.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Rahmi" carries a deeper spiritual significance within the Islamic tradition. It is a reminder of Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creation. The Quran mentions this often, such as in Surah Ar-Rahman where His mercy towards mankind is emphasized: "So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?" (Quran 55:1-3).
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Mercy, compassion" symbolizes The one who shows mercy and compassion. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rahmi serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of mercy, compassion.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 11, Page 112 The name Rahmi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The Seljuq Sultan Mohammad Tapar (1094-1113 AD) was known by the title 'Rahmi al-Din' during his rule. Rahmi means 'mercy', and this title was given to him because of his generous and merciful treatment towards his subjects.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Maqrizi, The History of Ibn Taghribirdi, Volume 2, Page 122 The name Rahmi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The Mamluk Sultan Al-Mu'ayyad Shah (1405-1414 AD) was also known by the title 'Rahmi al-Din'. Rahmi was a title given to him due to his generous and charitable deeds, especially towards the poor and needy.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rahmi originated from the Arabic language, which translates to 'merciful' or 'compassionate' in English. In modern times, the name Rahmi is increasingly associated with humanitarian aid and charitable work. Muslim charities and organizations often use the name Rahmi to reflect their mission of providing compassionate assistance to those in need. Rahmi is also seen on various social media platforms, where individuals and communities use the name to promote acts of kindness and empathy towards others. In the field of education, Rahmi is used to describe teachers or educational institutions that prioritize the emotional and social wellbeing of their students.

name_in_real_life.story: Maryam Rahmi, a teacher in Istanbul, Turkey, shares that their name Rahmi meaning "Mercy, compassion" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
